details.name: Updating an Element in the Array (Case 1)
details.description: Construct a program that initializes an array with three integers, changes the first element in the array, and finally, prints all the array elements.

details.name: Updating an Element in the Array (Case 2)
details.description: Construct a program that initializes an array with five floating-point numbers, changes the second element in the array, and finally, prints all the array elements.

details.name: Updating an Element in the Array (Case 3)
details.description: Construct a program that initializes an array with four strings, changes the last element in the array, and finally, prints all the array elements.
